localidad: Road to San Jose del Palmar, Serrania de las Paraguas, Choco
comentarios: song from a bird in a mixed flock, given in response to playback of the track on the Birds of the Colombian Andes.  I believe some of the calls on the track are also from this bird, though I don't know which ones.  Even in response to playback, the bird only sang a couple of times, and very quietly, sot this is the best I could get.
